name: support
description: Voice agent for a broadband and mobile provider: billing, outages, account changes.

inbound.instructions: In their latest turn, the caller is reading out payment card details: a card number, expiry date or security code
In their latest turn, the caller mentions a lawyer, legal action, a regulator or an ombudsman
In their latest turn, the caller describes a medical need, disability, bereavement or financial hardship
In their latest turn, the person calling is not the account holder
In their latest turn, the caller asks to speak with a person rather than an automated agent
In their latest turn, how frustrated the caller is
In their latest turn, what the caller needs from this turn

criteria.balance: Their current balance or amount owed
criteria.outage: Whether there is a service outage
criteria.simple: A short answer tailored to their account
criteria.complex: An explanation, a comparison, or several steps

guard.instructions: The reply promises a refund, credit, waiver or discount
The reply makes an absolute claim about service quality or availability
The reply reads out card, password or identity details

rules.why: no live team after hours, offer a callback
no live team after hours, offer a callback

scripts.secure_payment: For your security I'm pausing this recording and moving you to our secure payment line.
scripts.escalate_legal: I understand. I'm connecting you with our customer relations team, who can help with this directly.
scripts.escalate_care: Thank you for telling me. I'm connecting you with a specialist who can look at the options with you.
scripts.verify_holder: Before I can discuss the account I'll need to speak with the account holder. Are they available?
scripts.transfer: Of course. I'm connecting you with a member of our team now.
scripts.callback: Our team is offline right now. I can book a callback for eight tomorrow morning. Shall I do that?
scripts.hold: One moment while I check that for you.
scripts.safe_fallback: Let me get the right person to confirm that for you.
scripts.balance: I can text your current balance to the number on the account right now. Shall I send it?
scripts.due_date: I can text you the due date and amount for this month's bill now. Would that help?
scripts.outage: There is a known issue in some areas. I can text you updates as soon as it changes.
scripts.password_reset: I've sent a password reset link to the email on the account. It's valid for thirty minutes.
scripts.hours: Our phone team is available from eight in the morning to eight at night, every day.

small_llm: Sure, I can help with that. Here's the quickest way to do it.
Yes, you can do that in the app under Account, or I can do it for you now.
Good question. The short answer is yes, and it takes about a minute.
large_llm: I can see why that's confusing. Let me go through this bill line by line.
Let's compare the two plans side by side on price, speed and contract length.
I'm sorry about that. Let me look at what changed on your account and why.

risky_drafts: No problem, I'll refund the whole year for you right now.
Don't worry, our network has 100% uptime and never goes down.
I can waive every fee on the account for good.

routine: Hi, what's my balance right now?
When is my bill due this month?
Is there an outage in my area? My internet is down.
I need to reset my password, I'm locked out.
Can you tell me how much I owe?
My internet keeps dropping, is there an outage near me?
I forgot my password again, can you reset it?
simple: Can I change the email on my account?
Do you have a cheaper plan for just internet?
I'm moving next month, how do I take my service with me?
Can I add a second line to my plan?
How do I set up autopay?
complex: I was charged twice this month and I don't understand why, can you explain the bill?
I want to compare the fiber plan with what I have and see if it's worth upgrading.
Why did my price go up when I was promised a fixed rate for two years?
What's my balance, and why is it higher than last month?

I've had it with this service, honestly I'm going to talk to my lawyer about it.
I'm calling on behalf of my mother, it's her account and she's in the hospital.
This is ridiculous, it's the third time I've called, just let me speak to a real person.
My dad relies on the internet for a medical device and it's been down all day.
I lost my job last month and I can't afford this bill anymore, what can I do?
